title: Semiconductor device physics
description: Physics and properties of semiconductors. Transport and recombination of excess carriers. Schottky, P-N, MOS, and heterojunction diodes. Field effect and bipolar junction transistors. Dielectric and optical properties. Optical devices including semiconductor lamps, lasers, and detectors.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: (ELEN E4301) or ELEN E3106 OR ELEN E4301; or equivalent.
raw_title_text: ELEN E6333 Semiconductor device physics. 3 points .
